meta.title: Anomaly detection flags a wildly out-of-band bid
gaps: The available setup recipes provide at most two comparable bids, not three plus a fourth outlier.
No operation exposes a bid price for surrogate_bid, so a wildly out-of-band value cannot be supplied.
No read-back field or assertion op is available to verify an anomaly flag, message, or suggested price.
The available surrogate-bid library case describes exemption from anomaly detection, which conflicts with this expected behavior.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “the app answers without a server error”

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer enters a bid on a vendor's behalf (surrogate bid) for the invited QA vendor.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
